lede: Georgia State carries the stronger underlying team rating — -1.5 against -7.1, a 5.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Georgia State -12.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Georgia State winning 80% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is scheme fit, where Georgia State leads Northern Illinois by 102 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
